config_name: iPad Air 13-inch — M4 8-core CPU / 9-core GPU, 12GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 13" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C (USB 3 10Gb/s, DisplayPort), magnetic Magic Keyboard connector, Smart Connector
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard for iPad Air 13" included in price: scissor keys with full function row (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total; Pencil USB-C +$99; hover supported

battery.notes: 36.59Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi (9h cellular); users report ~8-8.5h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Tablet-only $1,729.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Air 13" $399.99 (BBY 19204078). Cellular variant +$200 ($1,929 tablet). Pencil Pro not included.

reviews.quote: The fiercest competitor for the iPad Pro is home-made. Pros: brute top performance, WiFi very fast, high-quality unibody chassis, USB-C with 10 GBit/s, two external displays possible, good color accuracy (PWM-free), well-balanced speakers, high recycled content. Cons: slow 60 Hz display, battery charging takes time, SoC throttles under sustained load. (NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026; 11" shares SoC and chassis design.)

praises: 512GB is the tier creators call the sane pick — ProRes/DaVinci projects and game libraries coexist without external drives (r/ipad)
M4 + 12GB unified memory handles multitrack 4K timelines that choke most thin laptops, silently
13" 600-nit fully-laminated anti-reflective panel is excellent in daylight and office light
Keyboard bundle with function row turns it into a real writing/machine work machine
USB-C external 6K display + Stage Manager gives a credible two-screen setup
complaints: Still 60Hz — the price crosses $2,100 with keyboard and the display is the one part that doesn't scale with it
At this price the $2,099 M5 Pro 13" (tandem OLED, 120Hz) is uncomfortably close on sale
LCD dark-room blacks vs OLED remain the recurring media-watching gripe
Keyboard keys unlit for late-night typing
iPadOS app ceiling (desktop-class apps, file-system friction) is the same as the $1,300 tier

design_philosophy: The Air's storage ladder lets buyers pay only for capacity, never for performance — every tier is the same M4/12GB machine. The 512GB 13" is the creator-leaning config: enough internal scratch for ProRes and large project libraries without stepping into 1TB money, though it starts trading blows with iPad Pro pricing.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026 (87%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from the 13" M4 256GB line anchor (SHARED-ipad-air.md): identical silicon/display; creative_work +0.3 for 512GB headroom (per SHARED storage-step rule). No verbatim pro score found (bot-walls) — disclosed, none invented. Ecosystem 6.5 per tablets rule; battery on ~8.3h real use. At $2,129 with keyboard it sits within ~$200 of the M5 Pro 13" 256GB on BBY sale — noted in complaints. Image URL is BBY CDN best guess (closest-SKU image).
standouts: Creator-sweet-spot storage tier: no external drive needed for 4K projects
Same silent M4 performance as every Air tier
dealbreakers: With keyboard it approaches iPad Pro 13" M5 sale pricing — the OLED/120Hz Pro becomes the rational buy at that money
